title: Seahawks place S Bud Clark, OL Mason Richman on IR

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks place S Bud Clark, OL Mason Richman on IR
sources.description: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said on Sunday that safety Bud Clark and offensive lineman Mason Richman would miss extended time after suffering injuries in Seattle's preseason game against the Titans.
